prompt: Generate one photoreal fashion portrait of the SAME Iranian adult woman in first collage; retain eye/face identity and natural skin but change expression. Fold scarf into a slim neck wrap tucked inside an off-white tailored blazer, with a short triangular silk point at one side carrying cobalt, olive cloud and bell motif; physically plausible square scarf. Mid torso editorial photo, one woman, no collage, no extra text/watermark.

qa.observations: Accepted: direct warm smile, low ponytail, compact cobalt neck wrap with dark bell flowers and olive cloud shapes. Central motif is partly hidden by realistic folds.
